Andhaka^2, an Asura killed by Rudra. § 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 49, 1937 (pureva Tryambakāndhakau).-§ 595 (Rāma Dāśarathi): VII, 59, 222{??} (pureva Tryambako 'ndhakaṃ).--§ 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.), VII, 155, †6726 (yathā 'ndhake pratinihate Haraṃ surāḥ); 156, 6818 (Maheśvara ivāndhakaṃ).--§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstram.): VII, 201, 9463 (Andhaka-nipātine, i.e. Rudra).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 146 (yathā Rudreṇa cāndhakaḥ).--§ 605 (do.): VIII, 20, 788 (Tryambakenāndhako yathā).
Andhaka-Bhoja. § 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 624 (putrau cāndhakabhojasya vṛddhau, among the defenders of the fortifications upon the Gomanta mountains, when Jarāsandha made his attack).
Andhakāraka, a mountain in Krauñcadvīpa. § 575 (Bhūmip.): VI, 12, 459, 463 (ºdeśāt).

Andhraka. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 119 (among the kings present when Yudhishṭhira entered his palace).
